scope_gaps.note: The title is unconditional (anyone). The NHS 6 h figure is stated in an insomnia self-help page, and the abstract of the meta-analysis does not state the population of the included studies.
Abstract-only snapshot: population, study designs and how the 8.8 h cut-off was derived are not in the abstract.
The abstract does not state dose, timing, population or the confidence interval of the 45 min result; the sentence says only 'Po kofeinie' in a pooled result.

The abstract gives 'at least' 8.8 h and 13.2 h, and only 'to avoid reductions in total sleep time'; the sentence omits both the minimum wording and that outcome, so a reader might take the figures as exact gaps or for any sleep outcome.
The 6 h figure is NHS advice for tea or coffee (bundled with smoking and alcohol) and is not a separate source of caffeine.

The abstract presents the 107 mg per 250 mL coffee and 217.5 mg pre-workout serve as the reference serves to which the 8.8 h and 13.2 h figures apply; it does not call them examples and gives no timing for other doses.
